map.依据《劳动合同法》计算解除/终止劳动合同的经济补偿金（N、N+1），支持月工资封: Calculates severance compensation for terminating or ending a labor contract under the Labor Contract Law (N and N+1), supporting the monthly wage cap and personal income tax estimation.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：(leaveDate.getFullYear() -: Core formula (by input variables): (leaveDate.getFullYear() - hireDate.getFullYear()) × 12 + (leaveDate.getMonth() - hireDate.getMonth()); 36000 × 0.03 + 108000 × 0.1 + 156000 × 0.2 + (taxableIncome - 300000) × 0.25; 36000 × 0.03 + 108000 × 0.1 + (taxableIncome - 144000) × 0.2
map.📖 查看「N+1补偿测算 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to N+1 compensation calculation
map.协商解除/无过失性解除（N+1）: Termination by mutual agreement / no-fault termination (N+1)
map.经济性裁员/合同到期不续签（N）: Economic redundancy / contract not renewed on expiry (N)
map.不满6个月按半个月工资补偿: Less than 6 months counts as half a month’s wage
map.协商解除场景：员工 2019-01-15 入职、2022-09-10 离职，工作: Mutual termination scenario: the employee joined on 2019-01-15 and leaves on 2022-09-10, with 3 years and 8 months of service; the average monthly wage over the 12 months before leaving is 15,000 CNY, and three times the local average monthly wage of the previous year is 30,000 CNY (so no cap applies). Years of service N = 4, N+1 compensation = 5 × 15,000 = 75,000 CNY, which is within the tax-free allowance and is received in full.
map.高收入封顶场景：员工工作 12 年 1 个月、月薪 50000 元、当地 3 倍: High-income cap scenario: the employee has 12 years and 1 month of service with a monthly wage of 50,000 CNY, while the local three-times cap is 30,000 CNY. Since the wage exceeds three times the average, it is counted as 30,000, and the years are capped at 12, so N = 12 and N+1 compensation = 13 × 30,000 = 390,000 CNY; the part above the tax-free allowance of 30,000 CNY is subject to personal income tax of about 900 CNY.
map.违法解除 2N 场景：同上高收入员工，用人单位违法解除按经济补偿标准二倍赔偿，2: Unlawful termination 2N scenario: for the same high-income employee, if the employer terminates the contract unlawfully, compensation is twice the economic compensation standard: 2N = 2 × 12 × 30,000 = 720,000 CNY, with estimated tax of about 58,080 CNY and a net amount of about 661,920 CNY.
map.算例：3 年 8 个月协商解除: Worked example: mutual termination after 3 years and 8 months
map.取入职 2019-01-15、离职 2022-09-10，总月数 = (2022: Take hire date 2019-01-15 and leaving date 2022-09-10: total months = (2022 − 2019) × 12 + (9 − 1) = 44 months; because the leaving day (10) is earlier than the hire day (15) no extra month is added, giving 3 full years and 8 remaining months (6 months or more counts as 1 year), so N = 4. The monthly wage of 15,000 is below the three-times cap, so the calculation wage is 15,000 CNY and N+1 compensation = 4 × 15,000 + 15,000 = 75,000 CNY; the tax-free allowance = (30,000 ÷ 3 × 12) × 3 = 360,000 CNY, so 75,000 CNY falls within the allowance, no tax is due, and the net amount received is 75,000 CNY.
map.工作年限“六个月以上不满一年按一年计算”如何把握？: How should the rule that six months or more but less than a year counts as one year be applied?
map.以整年数加剩余月判断：剩余月数 ≥6 按 +1 年，满 6 个月以下按 +0.5: Judge by full years plus the remaining months: 6 or more remaining months adds 1 year, while less than 6 months adds 0.5 years (turn off the option for less than 6 months counting as half a month to make it add 1 year instead). Example: 3 years and 8 months → N = 4.
map.月工资封顶后年限为何最高 12 年？: Why is service capped at 12 years once the monthly wage is capped?
map.依据《劳动合同法》第 47 条，劳动者月工资高于本地区上年度职工月平均工资三倍的: Under Article 47 of the Labor Contract Law, where an employee’s monthly wage exceeds three times the average monthly wage of employees in the region for the previous year, compensation is paid at three times that amount and the payment period may not exceed twelve years. High earners are capped on both the monthly wage and the number of years.
